summary: Ran 128 character-shift decoder attempts and 8 shift-invariance probes; 0 polynomial-style decoder(s) succeeded, 23 pair-ratio candidate filter(s) succeeded, 26 full-degree algebraic decoder(s) succeeded, and 31 candidate-enumeration baseline(s) succeeded.

Checked 8 multiplicative-character moment rows; 7 row(s) have all full-domain moments vanish through the low-degree window, 1 row(s) expose a low-degree moment signal, and 1 of those signal row(s) are classified as finite-size only.
Audited 8 multiplicative-character query-information rows; 8 row(s) have logarithmic random-sample query ceilings by pairwise agreement and union bound.
Ran 40 multiplicative-character shift elimination rows over 2 families, 4 n-values, and 5 sample budgets; 20 rows isolate the shift with polynomially many samples but exhaustive decoding.

Audited 12 shifted-character preprocessing row(s) and 48 literature upper-bound row(s). Fixed O(log p)-scale prefixes plus domain-size advice decoded 12 row(s); no unconditional superpolynomial decoding lower bound or natural-problem reduction is recorded.

Audited 32 multiplicative-character lower-bound rows; 22 random-sample and 28 chosen-query rows fingerprint shifts, while 23 rows are recovered by pair-ratio candidate filtering and 26 rows are recovered by full-degree cyclotomic GCD rather than a polynomial-style decoder.
